review: EN/HI written 13 Oct 2026, shown to the founder in the Group A screenshots

lines.text: Names and faces helps you remember the name of every new person you meet.
First, look at the face and notice one thing that stands out. Here: round glasses.
Next, turn the name into a picture. This is Kiran — and kiran means a ray of light.
Many names have a meaning you can picture: Akash is the sky, Neel is blue, Pankaj is a lotus. For other names, use a word that sounds like the name.
Now join the two: picture bright rays of light shining out of Kiran's round glasses.
Make the picture big, funny and moving — and say the name once in your mind.
When you see the face again, the glasses bring back the rays of light, and the light brings back the name: Kiran.
Let's practise. First two faces, then three.
